history.content: i dont really know why im here. nothing feels like anything lately
That sounds very quiet and hard to reach, like nothing is really landing. I can stay with that, or we can keep it this broad for now.
i dunno. like i made coffee this morning and just stood there. couldnt taste it i guess. or didnt care to
That feels more like blank or disconnected than calm, maybe a bit of both. What word feels closest?
disconnected i guess. everything just kinda runs together. days end and i dont remember doing anything. idk maybe thats normal

Disconnected fits, and the days running together gives it more of a low-access, blurred feel than simple not caring. I’m curious what seems to start it, or whether it just keeps going once it’s there.
it just keeps going i think. i cant point to a start. anyway idk what else to say. thanks for listening i guess
That feels like something that keeps humming along in the background, without a clear beginning. We can leave it here for now if you want, and that’s completely okay.
Of course. I’ll leave it there, and I’m glad you told me about it.
